ceramic.name: kärl, lerkärl
ceramic.title: kärl, lerkärl
ceramic.reason: A classic Zia polychrome pottery jar with the distinctive red bird motif (sacred water bird) outlined in black, a hallmark of Zia Pueblo pottery as noted in the museum's own description citing Clara Lee Tanner's reference work.

ceramic.name: storage-jar
ceramic.title: storage-jar
ceramic.reason: Classic Zia polychrome storage jar with the characteristic red-orange slip, bulbous body, and bird motif in the shoulder panel; this style of pottery is a hallmark Zia Pueblo craft.

ceramic.name: water-jar; olla
ceramic.title: water-jar; olla
ceramic.reason: A classic large polychrome Pueblo water jar (olla) with floral and geometric designs in black, white and red, explicitly attributed to Zia Pueblo by the museum; this matches the well-known Zia pottery tradition.

ceramic.name: skål, kärl
ceramic.title: skål, kärl
ceramic.reason: A classic white-slipped Zia Pueblo pottery bowl with red band and black geometric scalloped design along the rim, matching documented Zia polychrome ware from Sia Pueblo, New Mexico.

ceramic.name: kärl
ceramic.title: kärl
ceramic.reason: A polychrome Zia Pueblo storage jar with classic cream slip, orange band, and the sacred water bird (Zia roadrunner-like bird) motif described in the museum notes — a textbook Zia ceramic.

ceramic.name: skål, kärl
ceramic.title: skål, kärl
ceramic.reason: Small red-slipped pottery bowl with white and black geometric (triangle) decoration, consistent with traditional Zia Pueblo polychrome ceramics; museum record confirms it was collected from Zia Pueblo, New Mexico.
